verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Apify serves an llms.txt at docs.apify.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with an Apify Documentation header and summary). Many doc pages are also published as raw markdown (.md URLs), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is available, so an agent can be pointed at agent-friendly docs directly. Missing for 10: any visible evidence of the llms.txt's full contents or coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.apify.com/llms.txt # Apify Documentation
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.apify.com/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
